title: Open Mic @ MOTR Pub
event_description: Cincinnati's best open mic seven years running. Original music only - test new songs with professional sound and engaged audiences. Performers get $2 off sandwiches.
backline: Full PA system and professional sound engineers
event_venue_information:
MOTR Pub - Over-the-Rhine's Original Music Laboratory

MOTR has been OTR's beating heart for live music since 2010 presenting shows six nights weekly. The venue features multiple spaces including main performance room Sword Room and patio. Professional sound engineers and high-quality PA systems ensure performers sound their best.

Weekly Events

Tuesday open mic (original music) Monday karaoke Wednesday-Saturday ticketed concerts Sunday special programming. Kitchen open late with craft beers cocktails and elevated pub fare.

title: Bluegrass @ The Comet
event_description: The Comet Bluegrass All-Stars have performed every Sunday since 1996. Traditional and contemporary bluegrass in Northside dive bar with burritos and beer. Two shows nightly no cover.
backline: Acoustic instruments only - no backline provided
event_venue_information:
The Comet - Northside Music & Burrito Haven

Eclectic neighborhood bar with live music seven nights weekly pool tables darts outdoor patio tiki bar and sand volleyball. Kid-friendly during early hours especially Sunday bluegrass.

Music Programming

Sunday Bluegrass All-Stars (25+ year tradition) 2nd and 4th Thursday comedy open mic. Mexican food including enormous burritos quesadillas tacos. Huge beer selection and full bar.

title: Open Mic @ Leo Coffeehouse
event_description: Monthly open mic at 60+ year folk listening room run by Queen City Balladeers. Sign up for 1-2 songs (8 min limit). Attentive audience voluntary donations. September through May only.
event_venue_information:
Leo Coffeehouse - Listening Room Treasure

Operating since 1963 Leo is a civic treasure dedicated to folk and Americana music. All-volunteer Queen City Balladeers organization runs Sunday evening concerts September through May at Zion United Church of Christ.

Weekly Schedule

5:15 PM activities vary by week - open jam songwriters collaborative guitar roundtable old-time jam. 6:40 PM scheduled performances. Third Sundays feature open mic. Voluntary donations annual memberships available.

title: Open Jam @ Leo Coffeehouse
event_description: Weekly folk and Americana jam session. Anyone can lead songs while others provide backup and harmony. Part of Leo Coffeehouse Sunday programming. Runs until performances begin.
event_venue_information:
Leo Coffeehouse - Community Music Space

The Leo listening room is the jewel of Queen City Balladeers - a place where quality of attention matches quality of performance. Caffeinated atmosphere steeped in Americana music welcoming all genres.

Pre-Show Activities

Every Sunday 5:15 PM open jam. First Sundays Rise Up Singalong at 3 PM. Second Sundays Songwriters Collaborative. Third Sundays Guitar Roundtable. Fourth Sundays Old-Time Jam. Scheduled concerts 6:40-9:00 PM.

title: Open Mic @ The Vault Mt Lookout
event_description: Keep it Open Cincy returns to The Vault with music and comedy. Great food and drinks menu perfect layout for performances. No cover or entry fee. Sign up early for performance slots.
event_venue_information:
The Vault Mt Lookout

Mt Lookout venue hosting Keep it Open Cincy weekly open mic. Great food and drinks menu with layout perfect for music and comedy performances. Free event welcoming performers and audiences.

title: JAMII Community Open Mic @ Fountain Square
event_description: Youth-focused open mic (18 and younger) curated by Siri Imani. Features two local Cincinnati performers plus youth performances 7-8 PM. Free public event in downtown Cincinnati.
sign_up: Youth 18 and under can take the mic 7-8 PM
event_venue_information:
Fountain Square - Downtown Public Space

Cincinnati's premier public gathering space hosting free concerts and community events. JAMII (Swahili for Community) provides platform for young performers with professional sound systems downtown visibility.

Programming

Wednesday JAMII community musical nights featuring local performers and youth open mic. Sunday Sounds various free concerts. All events brought by Fifth Third Bank. No tickets required.

title: Comedy Open Mic @ The Comet
event_description: Git Gud Comedy Open Mic - no-pressure space for comics of all experience levels. Hosted by rotating local comedians. Sign-ups 6 PM mic starts 7 PM. Basement at The Comet.
hosts: Gavin Ferckel Wayne Memmott Connor Twele Cody Walker
event_venue_information:
The Comet - Comedy Platform

Northside neighborhood bar providing platform for developing comedians every 2nd and 4th Thursday. Basement venue with intimate atmosphere perfect for comedy. Built for community consistency and laughs.

Food and Atmosphere

Known for killer burritos cold beers underground vibes. Perfect backdrop for raw real standup comedy. Eclectic diverse welcoming crowd.

title: Bluegrass Night @ Arnold's
event_description: Wednesday bluegrass featuring Tye Dye and other bands in historic courtyard. Ohio's oldest tavern (since 1861) with live music Tuesday-Saturday. Beautiful courtyard setting great food.
event_venue_information:
Arnold's Bar and Grill - Historic Landmark

Ohio's oldest continuously operated tavern since 1861. Floors unchanged since 1860s tables from 1910s. Featured in Esquire Best Bars in America Thrillist Most Iconic Bar in Ohio.

Music and Dining

Live music Tuesday-Saturday in beautiful courtyard. Wednesday bluegrass night. Greek spaghetti famous meatballs burgers vegan options. Excellent beer selection full bar. Emilio Estevez is a regular.
